what: Unnumbered, unlabelled figure under Q.5 (right column, printed p172): curved section of the stomach wall showing an outer brown serosa, a purple muscular layer, a white loose submucosa and an inner dark-red folded mucosa (rugae); a single pointer line marks the folded mucosa at the top
